detailed_description:
Angular stylised 3D animation, brush-stroke texture, Surrey, 1894, midday sun from the left, black shadows.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:08. The shot opens on a medium shot at midday across the flat meadows at four armoured tripods far off, striding toward the river with a rolling motion, glittering in the sun. The camera is on the bank at a standing man's eye, a 50mm lens. The midday sun comes from the LEFT. At the first frame Four tall armoured tripods stride across the flat meadows at the CENTRE, far off, each a sixth of the height of the frame, glittering in the sun, the pollard willows along the BOTTOM third and the low flat horizon behind them. Cows graze in the meadow at the BOTTOM LEFT, and a thin haze of smoke rises over the far trees at the TOP RIGHT. The camera tracks sideways to the left past the pollard willows, a truck with small amplitude, until the four tripods already in the picture stand at the centre as the four tripods go on striding toward the river, from 00:00 to 00:04. At 00:04 the willows go on sliding by in the foreground, and the movement continues to the last frame of the shot. Beyond the foreground fugitives with bundles at the water's edge, a score of them, from 00:00 to 00:08. By 00:08 the camera is tracking through the last frame, and the action continues with it.
